Restoration Druid

Back to top

A guide to the live game, 1 to 60. Numbers are the client's at build 1.60.1.70938 with Blizzard's hotfixes through November 12. Talent orders are Icy Veins' and Wowhead's published builds, named and dated where they appear. Healing advice comes from those two sites and one creator's live dungeon video. WoWSims does not model Restoration. No raid is open until December 9, so nothing here rests on a raid log, and Wowhead's raid build advice was written before two changes to Wild GrowthWild GrowthLevel 40 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 3Cast3 sec castCost550 ManaRange40 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration7 secHeals the target and their party for 336 over 7 sec. Party members must be within 44 yards of target. The amount healed is applied quickly at first, and slows down as Wild Growth reaches its full duration. on November 10 and 12. If a tooltip differs from the text, go by the text.

What Restoration is for

Keeping a party up on heals that are already running before the damage lands. Every RejuvenationRejuvenationLevel 4 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 11CastInstantCost25 ManaRange40 yd rangeDuration12 secHeals the target for 32 over 12 sec. or RegrowthRegrowthLevel 12 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 9Cast2 sec castCost70 ManaRange40 yd rangeDuration21 secHeals a friendly target for 89 to 103 and another 91 over 21 sec. that runs its full duration pays out once more through BloomBloomTalentCastInstantWhen your Rejuvenation or Regrowth spell expires due to its duration, the target is instantly healed for an amount equal to 100% of your Spirit. If either spell expires due to being dispelled, the target is healed for 50% of your Spirit instead.. SwiftmendSwiftmendTalentCastInstantCost20% of base ManaRange40 yd rangeCooldown15 sec cooldownInstantly heals a target with your active Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect for an amount equal to the full duration of the periodic effect. turns one running RejuvenationRejuvenationLevel 4 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 11CastInstantCost25 ManaRange40 yd rangeDuration12 secHeals the target for 32 over 12 sec. or RegrowthRegrowthLevel 12 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 9Cast2 sec castCost70 ManaRange40 yd rangeDuration21 secHeals a friendly target for 89 to 103 and another 91 over 21 sec. into an instant heal for its full periodic amount, and leaves it running.

Both sites say the same thing about levelling in it. Icy Veins: "If you want to speed to Level 60, then we recommend leveling as Balance or Feral instead (you will still be able to heal dungeons)." Wowhead: a dedicated dungeon group is the case for it, and outside dungeons "you will find being specialized in Restoration to be a hindrance to questing and solo content." Its strengths in both lists: very hard to kill, and dungeons become easy.

The usual route is to level Feral or Balance and heal dungeons in that build. From 40 your class trainer sells Dual Specialization for 50 gold, per Wowhead, which is the cheap way to hold a healing build beside a levelling one.

Druid must channel to maintain the spell.: the sites disagree. It trains at 30 and heals the party every 2 seconds for 10 seconds on a 5-minute cooldown. Icy Veins: "quite strong in dungeon groups." Wowhead: "Not a useful button to press in WoW: Forever." Neither takes Improved TranquilityImproved TranquilityTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantReduces threat caused by Tranquility by 100% and its cooldown by 60%..

Mana. Innervate trains at 40. Icy Veins: use it on yourself on cooldown while levelling, and drink between packs. ReflectionReflectionTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantAllows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting. 3/3 keeps half your Spirit regeneration running while you cast, and stopping for 5 seconds brings back the rest.

Stat priority

Healing Power first. After that the two sites differ, and both say the order is provisional until level 60 fights have been seen.

  1. Icy Veins (November 4): Healing Power, Intellect, Spirit, Mana per 5 seconds, critical strike
  2. Wowhead (November 1, labelled speculative): Spell Healing, critical strike, spell haste, Spirit, Intellect, Mana per 5 seconds

Spirit is worth more than it looks. Living SpiritLiving SpiritTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantIncreases your Spirit by 15%. 3/3 is +15% Spirit, ReflectionReflectionTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantAllows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting. keeps half its regeneration going in combat, and BloomBloomTalentCastInstantWhen your Rejuvenation or Regrowth spell expires due to its duration, the target is instantly healed for an amount equal to 100% of your Spirit. If either spell expires due to being dispelled, the target is healed for 50% of your Spirit instead. heals for your Spirit. Wowhead puts BloomBloomTalentCastInstantWhen your Rejuvenation or Regrowth spell expires due to its duration, the target is instantly healed for an amount equal to 100% of your Spirit. If either spell expires due to being dispelled, the target is healed for 50% of your Spirit instead. at roughly 1 Spell Healing per point of Spirit when the heals are allowed to expire.

Haste does not speed up healing over time, and there are no haste breakpoints. Heal-over-time effects can crit, which both sites now confirm.

While levelling, Icy Veins says to take Spell Power as well as Healing Power, because your damage sets your levelling speed. Item level first: take the higher piece.
